international.notes: The International Relations Directorate manages semester exchanges with 413 partner universities in 53 countries and receives incoming exchange students. Its incoming requirements specify Spanish at CEFR B2. No official source located states that a Medicine course is taught in English.

profile_paragraphs: Universidad Mayor created its Faculty of Medicine and Health Sciences in 2022, replacing the former Faculty of Sciences. It brings together health schools in Santiago and Temuco, including Medicine.
The Medicine degree is a 14-semester daytime programme at Campus Huechuraba. It awards the professional title Médico Cirujano and the academic degree Licenciado(a) en Medicina.
Álvaro Erazo is the current dean. The faculty’s Huechuraba site houses most of its programmes and research laboratories, including the Centre for Precision Oncology.

For clinical teaching, the faculty publishes external placements across Santiago and Temuco, including public hospitals and Clínica RedSalud Mayor. Its history page reports more than 100 public and private clinical fields and identifies Clínica Bupa Santiago as a preferred field since 2019.

For a foreign rheumatologist, no standalone rheumatology specialty or university rheumatology unit was located. UMayor does run Internal Medicine specialty training, whose syllabus includes a Rheumatology rotation; entry requires a Chile-authorized medical qualification, EUNACOM, and for foreign doctors indefinite Chilean residence.
